# Diagnostics registry

<small>Source: [`R/diagnosticsRegistry.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/diagnosticsRegistry.R) · Help: `?.diagnostic_registry`</small>

Maintains a registry of diagnostic functions that can be called by
`runHeteroTests()` and `runDiagnostics()`. Users can register
custom diagnostics via `registerDiagnostic()`.

## Usage

```r
.diagnostic_registry
```

## Format

An object of class `environment` of length 16.
